remarks: Welcome to one of Brentwood’s finest custom homes in the gated Apple Hill Estates community, featuring 24/7 security and exceptional amenities including a pool and spa, tennis, pickleball and basketball courts, clubhouse, fitness center, children’s park, playground, walking trails and maintained greenbelts. Ideally positioned at the end of a quiet court, this meticulously updated custom home offers five bedrooms, five full bathrooms and a truly move-in-ready, nearly new feel, with owned solar for energy efficiency and long-term savings.
